name: vibecms
description: A minimal blog CMS for humans and AI agents, built for Cloudflare.

DB.description: D1 database for VibeCMS auth, content, activity, versions, and billing state. Keep the binding name as `DB`.

ASSETS_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for uploaded blog media. Keep the binding name as `ASSETS_BUCKET`.

APP_URL.description: Full deployed Worker URL, for example `https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev`.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Usually the same value as `APP_URL`. Better Auth uses this for auth URLs and callbacks.

PUBLIC_BLOG_DOMAIN.description: Worker hostname without protocol, for example `your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev`.

TOKEN_PEPPER.description: Required secret. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Used to hash VibeCMS API tokens.

scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply vibecms_dev --local
scripts.db:migrate:self-host:local: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:self-host:remote: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 execute vibecms_dev --local --file ../../packages/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:dev: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:seed:dev: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file ../../packages/db/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:self-host && pnpm db:migrate:self-host:remote && pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && pnpm --filter @vc/web-next build && pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && pnpm --filter @vc/web-next build && pnpm --filter @vc/web-next exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
